report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı normal. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Lateral femoral tibyal eklemdeki osteoartrit lateral femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyinde tam kata yakın fokal eklem kıkırdağı kaybına eşlik eden subkortikal medüller fibrovasküler-fibrokistik değişiklikler ile karakterize. Medyal femoral tibyal eklem dejenerasyonu daha hafif derecede ve medyal femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyindeki kondral kalınlığın %50'sini aşmayan kayıplara eşlik eden milimetrik boyutlu subkortikal medüller fibrovasküler değişiklikler ile karakterize. Lateral menisküs normal. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzu-gövdesi bileşkesindeki serbest kenara yakın üst ve alt eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkilenen kompleks dejeneratif yırtık gözleniyor. Femoral troklea displastik (Deojur tip A). Patella laterale 6 mm translasyon gösteriyor. Patellanın yüksekliği ve tibyal tüberkül yerleşimi normal. Ekstensör mekanizma bunların dışında korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is complete tear of the posterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.  
 There is grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament. The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Large amount of left knee effusion with synovitis is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.  -- Complete tear of the posterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.  
 -- Grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament. 
 -- Large amount of left knee effusion with synovitis.

Zentrierte Stellung im Kniegelenk. Patella zentriert. Gering suprapatellarer Erguss. Kein wesentliches Knochenmarksödem. Bis kraniokaudal 2,1 cm messende Läsion in der Tibiametaphyse gelegen mit randständiger Mehrsklerosierung und zentral fettisointensem Signal (5/25), keine kortikale Arrosion oder malignomsuspekte Stigmata. 
Unauffälliger Knorpelbesatz retropatellar und femorotibial. Intakte Darstellung des vorderen und hinteren Kreuzbandes, intakte Kollateralbänder. Geringe Signalanhebung bei mukoider Degeneration des Innenmeniskushinterhorns (6/7). Intakte Darstellung und Konfiguration des Außenmeniskus. Intakte Darstellung von Quadriceps- und Patellarsehne. Keine wesentliche Chondropathie femorotibial. Unauffällige Signalgebung der Muskulatur und subkutanen Weichgewebe.

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Ön çapraz bağın posterolateral demetinde ödem ile birlikte tibyal insersiyon tarafından düşük dereceli parsiyel yırtık gözleniyor. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları korunmuş. Lateral menisküs normal. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzunda alt eklem yüzü ile şüpheli olarak bir kesitte ilişkilenen lineer horizontal oblik hiperintensite izleniyor. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal). Posteromedyal köşedeki hafif dereceli ödem posteromedyal köşe sürtünme sendromu ile ilintili olabilir.

There is a moderately large knee effusion. A large bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus seen displaced into the midline is noted. Normal lateral meniscus.  ACL is ruptured. Mild anterior translation of the lateral tibial plateau is seen in relation to femur. Normal PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild - moderate thinning of the weightbearing aspect of the lateral femoral condylar articular cartilage with mild underlying bony change. Mild thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage is also noted. Normal patellofemoral articulation.  Conclusion: ACL rupture. Displaced bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus. Lateral femoral condylar articular cartilage injury.

Findings:  Small joint effusion. No intra-articular loose bodies. No sinister bone marrow changes.  Intact cruciates and collateral ligaments.  Intact lateral meniscus. Radial oblique tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.  Normal appearance of the pes anserine tendons, popliteus tendon, distal biceps femoris tendon and distal iliotibial band.  Intact extensor mechanism. No evidence of fat pad impingement.  Focal high-grade chondropathy in the lateral weightbearing aspect of the medial femoral condyle. Otherwise well-maintained tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage.  
Conclusion:  Small joint effusion. Radial oblique tearing of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.

MRI of right knee with SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

* A space-occupying lobulated cystic lesion in popliteal fossa, extended from the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius, showing hypointense in T1WI and hyperintense in T2WI and internal septums. R/O ganglion cyst. Differential diagnosis of synovial cyst, more than 6 cm in length..
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus in this study.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No significant bone marrow edema or active cortical destruction noted at distal femur and proximal tibia and fibula in this study.
> Spur formation and tiny subchondral cyst at femoral  trochlea, in favor of mild degneeration.

Impression:
1. Right popliteal cystic lesion, R/O ganglion cyst or bursal cyst along medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle/ tendon.
2. R/O mild degeneration of knee joint.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation.

Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones difusas en la señal de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales continuos, de grosor y señal normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal normales, sin evidencia de roturas.
Discreta irregularidad superficial del cartílago en zona de carga y central del cóndilo femoral
medial. Restantes cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales de espesor conservado, sin
otras lesiones focales significativas.
Irregularidad difusa del cartílago articular en el compartimento patelofemoral con extensas úlceras
de espesor parcial y total, estas últimas en el vértice y faceta lateral de la rótula asociado a focos
de edema óseo subcondrales así como también en la zona central de la vertiente lateral troclear.
Impresionan de discreta mayor extensión respecto a estudio previo.
Leve derrame articular. Pequeño quiste poplíteo de 6 mm, sin complicaciones evidentes.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, bíceps femoral, pata de ganso y banda iliotibial sin alteraciones.
Planos musculares de trofismo y señal normales.
Grasa de Hoffa aumentada de señal en su aspecto superoexterno.
Articulación tibioperonea proximal sin alteraciones.
Impresión:
Condropatía difusa patelofemoral, grado 4, de discreta mayor extensión respecto a estudio previo.
Condropatía superficial focal en el aspecto central del cóndilo femoral medial, grado 1-2.
Leve derrame articular.
Signos de hiperpresión patelar externa.
Pequeño quiste poplíteo no complicado.

Technique: MRI of the knee. ACL normal. MCL normal. Lateral meniscus normal. OA of all three compartments. Mucoid degeneration of posterior horn of medial mniscus. Old osteochondral fracture of medial caudal patella. Distorsion of medial patellar retinaculum. Baker's cyst. Mild effusion. Conclusion: Old osteochondral fracture of medial caudal patella.

Unauffälliges Knochenmarksignal, vordokumentiertes Knochenödem in der medialen Tibia bei vormals mutmaßlich kortikaler Impression vollständig regredient. Keine frische Fraktur. Kreuzbänder intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt. Ausgeprägte Chondropathie medialseitig und initial auch retropatellar ohne durchgreifenden Befundwandel zu 09/22. Flaue Signalanhebung des Innenmeniskus am Übergang Pars intermedia zum Hinterhorn am freien Rand und basisnah, beginnende Auffaserung möglich (4/23). Gelenkflüssigkeit im physiologischen Ausmaß.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Rotura meniscal.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior del menisco medial que no impresiona contactar
con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
Aumento de señal de la raíz meniscal posterior y cuerno posterior del menisco lateral sugieren una
rotura con leve extrusión meniscal.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la región central y posterior de platillo tibial lateral,
sin cambios óseos secundarios. En tórax condrales de espesor parcial del cóndilo femoral lateral.
Cartílagos del compartimento femorotibial medial y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Úlceras condrales de espesor total con cambios óseos secundarios de distribución difusa de la
rótula.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales. Leve engrosamiento y aumento de señal del tercio
proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Mínimo derrame articular con discreta sinovitis. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Impresión:
Signos de una rotura degenerativa de la raíz meniscal posterior y parte del cuerno posterior del
menisco lateral con mínima extrusión meniscal.
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 de platillo tibial lateral y grado 2 del cóndilo femoral lateral.
Condropatía con lesiones grado 4 de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular con mínima sinovitis.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Small joint effusion. No popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Normal.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Normal.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Grade 1 anterior cruciate ligament sprain. No significant tear identified. Mild increased T2 signal intensity within the mid and proximal fibers.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Normal.

Bones:
Normal.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:
Small right knee joint effusion
Possible subtle grade 1 anterior cruciate ligament sprain.
Otherwise no internal derangement of the ligaments or menisci is identified.

Regelrechte Stellungsverhältnisse. Retropatellararthrose sowie knöcherne Ausziehungen im Bereich der Quadrizepssehnen-Insertion. Medial betonte Gonarthrose mit osteophytären Randausziehungen sowie deutlicher Gelenkspaltverschmälerung und korrespondierendem Knochenmarködem des medialen Tibiaplateaus. Der Innenmeniskus exkludiert mit komplexer Rissbildung der Hinterhorns. Tiefergreifende Chondropathie im medialen Kompartiment. Der Knorpelbesatz auch im lateralen Kompartment ausgedünnt imponierend. Geringe Chondropathie der lateralen Patellafacette. Neben oben genannte Knochenmarködem des lateralen Tibiaplateaus allseits regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Kein frischer Frakturnachweis. Regelrechte Konfiguration des Außenmeniskus, keine Rissbildung. VKB deutlich aufgetrieben, DD bei zurückliegender Ruptur; aktuell einzelne Faserzüge wohl duchziehend. HKB sowie die Kollateralbänder intakt. Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne intakt ohne Signalalteration. Ostephytäre Randanbauten an der Patellabasis an der Inserton der Quadricepssehne. Mäßiger Gelenkerguss, Synovialitis. Geringe subkutane Flüssigkeitseinlagerungen.

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı minimal artmış. Ön çapraz bağın anteromedyal demeti ödemli olup bağ kalınlığınının %50'sini aşmayan parsiyel yırtık ile birlikte. Ön çapraz bağın tibyal insersiyonu düzeyinde anteriyor komşuluğundaki yırtılmış-retrakte bağlar ile uyumlu nodüler hiperintensite ve Hoffa'nın yağ yastığının santralinde - lateral yarısında gözlenen ligamentum mukozum (infrapatellar plika) trasesindeki ödem varlığında bulgular infrapatellar plika yaralanmasını telkin ediyor. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar korunmuş. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzu-gövdesi bileşkesindeki dejenerasyona yırtık eşlik etmiyor. Lateral menisküs normal. Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları korunmuş. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal).

The study reveals normal knee joint alignment, no definite fracture line noted.  
 Mild focal bone contusion at posterior lateral proximal tibia and mid lateral femoral condyle is noted. 
  
 - There is thickening hyperintense strands in the proximal to distal ACL. 
    PCL is intact.   No definite anterior tibial translation is noted.   
  
 - MCL is intact.    Hyperintense along posterior meniscocapsular region is noted.  
    
  No osteochondral lesion is detected.  
  
 -  FCL, popliteus tendon, biceps femoris tendon are preserved.  
    Lateral meniscus is not torn. 
  
 - The PF joint and joint surface are preserved.   
    Minimal joint effusion is seen. 
    Quadriceps and patellar tendons are preserved.        -  Probably intrasubstance partial tear ACL,  
   
     -   Probably posterior meniscocapsular injury of the medial meniscus

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Sospecha de quiste parameniscal.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Aumento de señal central de parte del cuerno anterior, cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco
medial que impresiona contactar la superficie articular inferior de manera periférica a nivel del
cuerpo. Esto se asocia a formación quística polilobulada adyacente que se extiende superficial al
ligamento colateral medial que mide aproximadamente 38 x 26 mm en sus ejes anteroposterior y
cefalocaudal respectivamente con un espesor aproximado de 8 mm.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial la faceta medial de la rótula.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del
rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Mínimo edema de las partes blandas entre la banda y del cóndilo femoral lateral. No hay
alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Imagen altamente sugerente de una rotura de predominio periférico del menisco medial asociado
a quiste parameniscal que se extiende superficial al complejo ligamentario medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal y cuadricipital distal.
Fenómenos de fricción peritrocantéricos

MRI of left Knee with 
-3-Plane Loc R'T, Sag PD FS, AX T2 FS, Sag T2 FS, Sag T1, CORT2 FS

> There is no abnormal intensity or articular surface disrupt in the medial meniscus, It appears to be normal.
> There is no increased intensity in the ACL, MCL and LCL, it appears to be normal
> Interstitial high intensity, irregular contour and laxity in the PCL, suspected complete tear
> Synovial membrane thickening in the knee joint with fluid accumulation and hofa fat pad stranding, knee arthritis with hoffitis noted
> Fluid accumulated in the suprapatella bursa with quadricep and prefemoral fat pad stranding, suprapatellar bursitis noted
> Fluid accumulated in the posterior medial condyle region
> Medial plica and suprapatellar plicae noted
> Relatively enlarged caliber of the popliteal vein  with heterogenous hyperintensity (srs: 6, Img: 24-30) and prominenet superficial veines, the possiblity of deep vein thrombosis can't totally excluded.

Impression:
1. C/W PCL complete tear, grade 3 injury
2. Synovitis of left knee and massive joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis; complex plicae.
3. Subcutaneous edema around left knee.
4. R/O deep vein thrombosis of left popliteal vein. Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena nalazi se lezija I. stupnja medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Entezopatske promjene proksimalnog hvatišta lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Umjerena mukoidna degeneracija prednjeg križnog ligamenta uz sitne ganglion ciste u području
obaju hvatišta.
Blaže degenerativno promijenjen stražnji križni ligament.
Horizontalna ruptura prednjeg roga i dijela tijela lateralnog meniska, anteriorno se širi u dio
vlakana prednjeg korijena.
Medijalni menisk uredne je morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Fisura hrskavice lateralnog kondila femura u nosivom dijelu u smislu hondromalacije III.stupnja
prema ICRS klasifikaciji. Hondromalacija II. stupnja hrskavice medijalnog kondila femura te I.
stupnja tibijalne hrskavice.
Ostale prikazane artikulacijske hrskavice urednih su intenziteta signala.
Nesignifikantan izljev u koljenu. Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste. U području
posteriorne kapsule ovalna formacija niskih intenziteta signala na svim učinjenim sekvencama,
veličine 10 x 4 x 9 mm, uz manji okolni izljev - kalcifikat?
Entezopatske promjene tetive kvadricepsa, moguća parcijalna ruptura pri hvatištu za patelu.
Zadebljan je patelarni ligament uz inhomogen prikaz vlakana i promijenjen intenzitet signala,
smanjene napetosti - stanje po rupturi? Entezopatske promjene patelarnog hvatišta.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular:Lateral menisküs anterior-posterior hornu ve gövde kesimde grade II dejenerasyon izlenmiştir. Media menisküs diz eklem mesafesinden 5 mm mediale esktrüdedir. Menisküs posterior hornu ve gövde kesimde grade III dejenerasyon izlenmiştir. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Anterior çapraz bağda diffüz incelme ve miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Gastroknemius medial krus proksimal insersio düzeyinde tendinozis ile uyumlu sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir. Suprapatellar bursada ve diz eklem mesafesinde minimal sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Diz eklemini oluşturan her üç kompartmanda santral-marjinal osteofit formasyonu izlenmiştir. Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında hafif daralma, ekleme komşu femoral ve tibial kartilajda incelme izlenmiştir. SONUÇ: Gonartroz. Medial menisküste mediale ekstrüzyon ve grade III meniskopati. Lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati. Anterior çapraz bağda diffüz inceleme ve miksoid dejenerasyon. Suprapatellar hafif bursit, diz ekleminde sinovit. Gastroknemius medial krusu tendinozisi.

The study reveals narrowing of the medial tibiofemoral joint, with full thickness cartilage loss at weightbearing part of the medial femoral condyle, about 1.6x2.3cm.,  and severe chondrosis at tibial plateau, with mild subchondral bone edema.   
    Mild medial bulging medial meniscus with myxoid change,  without meniscal tear is observed.   MCL is intact.  
   FCL, popliteus and biceps femoris tendons are preserved.  Lateral meniscus is not torn.   
     Diffuse chondrosis of the lateral femoral condyle and tibial plateau is observed.  
  Normal orientation of ACL with intact ligament fiber is observed.   PCL is intact.  
  Thinning articular cartilage with illdefined hyperintense lesions along medial and lateral PF joint are noted.   
  Small marginal osteophytes along medial and lateral tibiofemoral and PF joint are observed.  
    Minimal amount of joint effusion and fluid distended suprapatellar bursa with mild thickened synovial tissue are seen.  
   The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.     Full thickness cartilage loss at weightbearing part of the medial femoral condyle, about 1.6x2.3cm.,grade 4 chondropathy, and severe chondrosis at medial tibial plateau, 
      Diffuse chondrosis of the lateral tibiofemoral joint 
      Grade 3 chondrosis of the PF joints, with evidence of PF synovitis and suprapatellar bursitis 
  
         Secondary OA change of the knee and PF joint,  
  
  Myxoid degenerative change of medial meniscus without tear

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve meniskal kökünde parsiyel yırtık ile uyumlu görünüm izlenmiştir. Medial menisküs hafif ekstrude görünümdedir. Lateral menisküste grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Medial  kollateral ligamen çevresinde periligamentöz ödem ile uyumlu görünüm mevcuttur ( grade I sprain ). Ön çapraz bağda diffüz sinyal artışı izlendi (miksoid dejenerasyon).Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Patellar kıkırdakta belirgin incelme ve komşu kemikte subkondrial kemik iliği ödemi ve milimetrik kist izlendi ( grade II kondromalazi ).Suprapatellar bursada her iki reseslerde hafif sıvı artışları izlendi. Prepatellar düzeyde cilt altı yağlı dokuda ödematöz görünüm mevcuttur.Patellar tendon tibia yapışma düzeyinde hafif fokal sinyal artışı ve infrapatellar bursada minimal sıvı artışı izlendi. Gastrocnemius medial krus tendonunun femur yapışma düzeyinde kalınlık ve sinyal artışı izlendi.Tibiofemoral eklem medial düzeyde eklem mesafesinde daralma,  medial kondilde subkondrial milimetrik kist ve kemik iliği ödemi, bu düzeyde medial kondilde subkondrial kemik iliği ödemi ve milimetrik kist izlendi. Bu düzeyde kartilajlarda hafif incelmeler izlendi.  Tibia interkondiler tüberkül ACL yapışma düzeyinde subkondrial kemik iliği ödemi, milimetrik kistler izlendi.

Regelrechte Artikulation im linken Kniegelenk. Patella zentriert stehend. Unauffälliger Knorpelbelag femoropatellar. Am unteren Patellapol diskrete T2 Signalanhebungen (9/19). Die Patellasehne stellt sich jedoch unauffällig dar. Ansonsten unauffällige Signalgebung des Knochenmarks. Kein intraossäres Ödem.

Unauffällige Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellasehne. Diskrete Signalanhebung im Hoffa'schen Fettkörper (3/17). Kein Gelenkerguss. Kleine synoviale Aussackung posterior des Innenmeniskus. Unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Muskulatur und der Subkutis.

The extensor mechanism is intact and unremarkable apart from very subtle increased signal seen in the proximal patellar tendon laterally. There is associated focal edema seen within Hoffa's fat pad inferior to the lateral aspect of the lower pole of patella also involving the lateral edge of the patellar tendon. Findings are consistent with mild lateral patellar tendinosis. Edema in Hoffa's fat may be associated with extensor mechanism impingement.

There is focal signal change and irregularity of the articular cartilage of the medial facet of patella consistent with moderate chondrosis. The remainder of the articular cartilage of patella is well-maintained. The trochlear articular cartilage is also reasonably preserved.

The TT-TG distance measures about 1 cm, within normal limits.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

The medial meniscus appears intact with no surfacing tear demonstrated. Immediately adjacent to the posterior horn of medial meniscus tracking along the joint margin posteriorly from the posterior root attachment medially to the medial joint margin deep to the semimembranosus and semitendinosus tendons there is a large multiloculated parameniscal cyst. This measures about 3.7 cm in length with short axis measurements of up to 1.2 x 0.9 cm.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex are intact.

There is no Baker's cyst or knee effusion demonstrated.

INTERPRETATION: 

Moderate chondromalacia patella.

Mild patellar tendinosis with edema in Hoffa's fat pad laterally. The edema may indicate presence of extensor mechanism impingement of Hoffa's fat pad.

There is a large para meniscal cyst closely associated with the posterior horn and body of medial meniscus. There is no discernible, associated medial meniscal tear identified.

No evidence of internal derangement.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Mild to moderate effusion. No popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
There is mild irregularity and thickening of the medial collateral ligament with partial discontinuity, suggestive of high-grade tear.
There is no evidence of meniscal injury

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Normal.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
There is irregularity and increased signal intensity within the anterior cruciate ligament, which also appears discontinuous. Complete tear is suspected.
Posterior cruciate ligament is intact.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Normal

Bones:
There is bone contusion involving lateral femoral epicondyle, medial femoral condyle and lateral aspect of the tibial plateau. There is very mild subchondral impaction in the lateral femoral epicondyle which could represent microtrabecular fracture.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
There is mild increased signal intensity within the soft tissue lateral to the lateral femoral condyle, likely presents post traumatic changes.

CONCLUSION:
1.Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament
2.High-grade, likely complete tear of the medial collateral ligament.
3.Bone contusion involving lateral and medial femoral epicondyle and lateral aspect of the tibial plateau with possible microtrabecular fracture involving lateral femoral epicondyle.
